scripts.dev: npm run data && npm run build:demo && concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "vite" "node server/index.mjs"
scripts.build:demo: npm run data && vite build --config vite.demo.config.js
scripts.build:all: npm run build:public && npm run build:demo
scripts.pages:dev: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=carsystem-demo
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build:firebase && firebase deploy --only hosting --project car-system-solution
